extracted.intended_audience: researchers, historians, librarians, and general readers interested in early-17th-century Virginia colonial sources and digital-archive users
extracted.subtask_description: Catalog/metadata and download page for a 1622 printed declaration on the state of the Virginia colony by Edward Waterhouse, including an annexed treatise by Henry Briggs and related materials. The page provides bibliographic details, table of contents, scanning metadata, and download options for the digitized item.
